_comment: Your personal editing preferences. Edit this file any time to change how videos are cut and captioned — no code changes needed. Paths use ~ for your home folder.

folders._note: raw is where you drop new footage. transcripts and output (finished videos) are separate folders. All three are created automatically by install.ps1 if missing.

spelling._note: Words/phrases here are protected: if the transcriber mishears them (e.g. 'tim dial', 'andurance'), the caption text is auto-corrected to the exact spelling listed. This only fixes caption text, not audio.

editing._note: silence_threshold_db: quieter than this counts as 'dead air'. min_silence_to_cut_seconds: only pauses at least this long get trimmed (shorter natural pauses are left alone). keep_padding_seconds: a small buffer left on each side of a cut so speech doesn't sound clipped. remove_stutter_repeats: cuts immediate word repeats like 'the the' or restarted false starts ('I was— I want to say').

quality_check._note: Before handing you a finished video, the pipeline re-transcribes the FINAL audio independently and diffs it word-for-word against the burned-in captions, and checks the final duration matches the sum of kept segments within max_duration_drift_seconds. Any mismatch is written to the QC report instead of being silently ignored.
